name: One-line minimal-change rule
summary: "Make the smallest change that solves the task; add no features, abstractions or dependencies nobody asked for." The reference arm for Ponytail, about 30 tokens.

evidence.setting: a different one-sentence prompt (asking for a runnable check), Sonnet 5, Claude Code 2.1.220
evidence.effect: cost -5.8% [-11.7, +1.1] vs no add-on (not significant); no test of this wording

killTest.hypothesis: Ponytail 5.3.3 beats both no add-on and the one-line rule
killTest.pass: Wins against both, with Bash on, instruction files present and subagents allowed
killTest.budget: 40 tasks x 3 arms x 2 runs; 2 weeks
killTest.ifFails: Assess; existing users see the result with an offer to remove

maintenance: Owned text, maintained in this repository.
